source.title: Product leadership alert: 2 new job(s)
source.body:

## 1. Hirify

- **Location:** USA

> TL;DR. VP Product Marketing (eCommerce): Define and scale a global product marketing organization, owning go-to-market strategy, product positioning, and messaging for eCommerce software solutions with an accent on driving market demand and accelerating growth.
